verdict.rationale: Notion's database/relation model and 'system of record' framing plausibly support dependency tracking across teams, and community notes confirm real-world use as a project/issue tracker, but no evidence specifically documents relation/rollup properties, dependency views, or cross-team launch coordination features, and one community report explicitly says using Notion as a project tracker 'quickly hit limits requiring manual maintenance.' missing for 10: explicit documentation of relation/dependency properties, timeline/Gantt views for launches, and hands-on evidence of successful cross-team dependency coordination.
